text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health capital budget variance for the three months ended on March 31, 2018. Toronto Public Health spent $0.712 million, representing 15.6 percent of the 2018 Approved Capital Budget of $4.575 million.
The Board of Health Budget Committee recommends to the Board of Health that: 1. The report (June 4, 2018) from the Medical Officer of Health be received for information.
